newsitem.title: GERMANY: GOLF-NECK INJURIES STRIKE TWICE AT PLAYERS' CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-NECK INJURIES STRIKE TWICE AT PLAYERS' CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Injury-prone Sam Torrance had to pull out of the European Tournament Players' Championship shortly before the start on Thursday.
The veteran of the last eight Ryder Cups for Europe pulled a muscle in his neck climbing out of bed on Wednesday.
His replacement, fellow Briton Warren Bennett, played only nine holes -- then he withdrew for the same reason.

Torrance had tried to go through his practice routine before playing the first round but could not swing properly and had to quit without going to the tee. He had spent much of Wednesday undergoing intense physiotherapy treatment.
Torrance has had several minor injuries over the past year and has suffered numerous mishaps in his career, including the 1993 Ryder Cup when he missed the singles because of an infected toe.
